subject: Polestar SIG review, evidence plan & escalation register
messages:
From: Alex Morton <alex@polestar.io>
To: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@polestar.io>, Dylan Ross <dylan.ross@secpartners.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG + CAIQ review window and evidence handoff

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Polestar would like to move forward with a SIG/CAIQ review before procurement. We have a tight internal review window the week of Apr 19. Can we schedule a 60-minute deep-dive to: 1) walk the SIG answers you provide, 2) review required evidence artifacts (logs, key rotation proof, architecture diagram), and 3) agree on an escalation path in case we need quick follow-ups?

High-level asks from our compliance team:
- A filled SIG spreadsheet (we can accept Redwood's template)
- Network architecture diagram that shows egress controls and VPC peering
- A redacted sample of audit logs (last 7 days) and guidance on retention policy

Attaching our intake template for reference (Polestar_SIG_Template_v0.2). Also copying our security consultant Dylan.

Doable? If yes, please propose two time slots.

Best,
Alex Morton
Head of IT Risk | Polestar Systems
attachment: Polestar_SIG_Template_v0.2.xlsx

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morton <alex@polestar.io>
Cc: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG + CAIQ review window and evidence handoff

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can cover all three bullets in a 60-minute session. Proposed slots:
- Tue Apr 20, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Apr 21, 13:00–14:00 PT

What we'll prepare ahead of the call:
- A Redwood-completed SIG export (we'll start with our latest CAIQ-derived answers).
- Network diagram (see draft attached) and short notes on VPC peering / egress controls.
- Steps to produce a redacted log sample and a short summary of retention policy, including where logs are stored and how long they are retained.

Internal note: Ben, can you lead on generating the redacted logs and a short readme for uploading to their intake folder? Irene, please prep the SIG export and mark any questions we want Polestar to answer live. Marissa, I'll need your help on the escalation register (who to call for certs/SOC2 evidence on a weekend).

We'll attach a draft evidence register that maps SIG questions to artifacts + owners.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachment: redwood_sig_export_draft.xlsx, polestar-network-architecture.png

- For the log sample, please include one end-to-end request trace (redacted) and a short note about RTO/RPO for logs.

What you'll find:
- redwood_sig_export_draft.xlsx (SIG mapped to artifacts)
- polestar-network-architecture.png (annotated, shows NAT egress + VPC peering)
- sample_logs_export_20270409.tar.gz (redacted request trace + readme.txt)
- escalation_register.md (who to call + weekend on-call flow)

Quick answers to Priya's questions:
- Naming convention: service-account-<env>-<svc>-<region> (we included the pattern in the readme).
- Key storage: secrets are in a KMS-backed vault; we do not store primary keys in plaintext in repos. See escalation_register.md for contact to retrieve audit proof if your legal team needs it.

Agenda for Tue Apr 20, 10:00 PT (60m)
1) 5m introductions & scope
2) 25m SIG walkthrough (Irene)
3) 15m Evidence review — logs & architecture (Ben + Jonas)
4) 10m Escalation path & next steps (Marissa)

If anything urgent comes up before the call, call my cell — Jonas Weber +1 (415) 555-0123 (for escalation only).

See you Tue — attaching the final files to the folder.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
